# Catherine Curtis

Catherine Curtis is the current Deputy of [District 5](https://flow.je/elections/district-5) and a member of [Reform Jersey](https://flow.je/elections/parties/reform-jersey). She was first elected to the States of Jersey in 2022.

Catherine Curtis has participated in 1 election since 2002:

- [**2022 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/catherine-curtis#e48)

  Elected as Deputy of District 5 with 55.3% of the ballot.

  - [2022 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2022/catherine-curtis/)
  - [2022 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DHbskbly5nc)
  - [2022 Jersey Evangelical Alliance Survey](https://www.jerseyevangelicalalliance.org.je/s/Catherine-Curtis-Deputy-St-Helier-Central-JEA-Questionnaire.pdf)
  - [2022 SCOOP Food Security Questionnaire](https://drive.google.com/uc?export=view&id=1kI5ESEJ4byHHwSp76kLGeBkayQSQynP9#page=39)

Catherine Curtis has declared her intention to stand in the upcoming [2026 Deputies Election](https://flow.je/elections/2026) in [District 5](https://flow.je/elections/district-5), representing [Reform Jersey](https://flow.je/elections/parties/reform-jersey). \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/03/31/reform-jersey-deputy-to-seek-second-term/)\]
